title: cleistanthus acuminatus
intro: Cleistanthus acuminatus, commonly known as the Bhumyamalaki, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. The Bhumyamalaki plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of liver and gallbladder disorders, as well as its antidiabetic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleistanthus acuminatus include hepatoprotective, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Bhumyamalaki plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
